quest.title: Adventure at Wavey Bay
quest.description: Mualani seems excited about the Wavey Bay attractions. Go meet up with her!

talks.objective: Reach the entrance to the sports area

dialogues.speaker: Kaulu
dialogues.text: This is our star parade attraction. Could you lend us a hand?

dialogues.speaker: "Muchih"
dialogues.text: An easy-breezy Natlan in an easy-breezy summer! Welcome to Wavey Bay!

dialogues.speaker: "Muchih"
dialogues.text: Our facilities aren't fully ready yet. If you're eager to participate, feel free to lend a hand.

talks.objective: Go to the cruise ship and assist the staff

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Thank you! Please give our attraction a try, too.

talks.objective: Talk to the staff to learn about the situation

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Ooh, perfect timing! Perhaps you could help me test this facility?

talks.objective: Complete the cruise ship's trial run
Go to the second part of the cruise route and assist the staff

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: This one's even further behind... technically, it's still under construction.

talks.objective: Talk to the staff to begin the challenge
Use the ability of an Iktomisaur to complete construction on the second part of the cruise route
Complete the cruise ship's trial run of the second part of the cruise route
Go to "Asha Speedrun" and assist the staff

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you again! Without your help, I'd be out of a job by now.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Greet our tester and start testing!

talks.objective: Help the staff complete Asha Speedrun's trial run
The hot air balloon takes off
Begin the Razzle-Dazzle Mega Slide challenge
Assist with the Razzle-Dazzle Mega Slide preparations
